posts.title: I’m 16. I have never built hardware. So I published the parts I got wrong.
posts.description: Vyldor is still renders, specifications and code. It is also the clearest evidence I can give that I will keep working when the first version is wrong.

posts.title: Every AI wearable we were told to admire is now switched off
posts.description: Humane raised $230m, sold for $116m and bricked its customers' devices. Limitless was absorbed by Meta. The pattern is not bad luck, and it decided how we designed ours.
